items.title: New GhostTree Attack Causing EDR Products to Hang and Leave Files Unscanned
items.description: A novel evasion technique called GhostTree, which exploits NTFS junctions to create recursive directory loops. Uncovered by Varonis Threat Labs, this method traps Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) scanners in infinite paths, causing them to hang and ignore malicious payloads. NTFS junctions function as advanced shortcuts that redirect applications from one directory to another seamlessly.…
